data.title: Preview: Werder Bremen vs Borussia Monchengladbach - prediction, team news, lineups - Sports Mole
data.content:
## Team News

Bremen's injury list remains extensive, with forwards Salim Musah and Keke Topp, as well as midfielder Jens Stage, among those set to miss out.

Striker Niclas Fullkrug will likely make up for any attacking absentees given he has scored in eight of his last nine Bundesliga games.

Youri Regeer and Ludovit Reis may be trusted to start in a double pivot, with the duo tasked with protecting defenders Amos Pieper and Marco Friedl. [...] Gladbach centre-forward Tim Kleindienst is nearing a return from injury but has been ruled out of Friday's clash, meaning Shuto Machino will lead the line.

With centre-back Enzo Leopold set to miss almost the entire season due to a cruciate ligament injury, expect to see Kevin Diks, Philipp Sander and Fabio Chiarodia in a three-man defence.

Werder Bremen possible starting lineup:

Hein; Arthur, Pieper, Friedl, Deman; Regeer, Reis; Dinkci, Chuki, Njinmah; Fullkrug [...] Borussia Monchengladbach possible starting lineup:

Batz; Diks, Sander, Chiarodia; Scally, Uno, Neuhaus, Castrop; Hack, Mohya; Machino

## We say: Werder Bremen 2-0 Borussia Monchengladbach

Bremen have been outstanding at home this season, and they should be confident with Fullkrug up front.

Gladbach may have somewhat improved at the back under Blessin, but their lack of threat in the final third is likely to cost them on Friday.

data.title: Werder Bremen vs Borussia Mönchengladbach Prediction and Betting Tips | November 27th 2026
data.content:
## Werder Bremen vs Borussia Mönchengladbach Prediction

Despite the comparable quality of the two squads, Die Werderaner are strong favorites for the weekend clash, having enjoyed considerably better form and excelled on home soil this season.

We are tipping Daniel Thioune's men to come out on top.

Prediction: Werder Bremen 3-1 Borussia Mönchengladbach

## Werder Bremen vs Borussia Mönchengladbach Betting Tips

Tip 1 - Result: Werder Bremen to win [...] - Bremen took four points from their two league encounters with Mönchengladbach last season.
- Die Fohlen have visited the Weserstadion nine times in the past decade, losing just once during that period.
- Gladbach hold the joint-worst defensive record in the German top flight this term, having conceded 26 goals in just 10 matches. [...] Three different players found the back of the net to seal the points for Bremen, including the resurgent Niclas Füllkrug, who netted his 10th league goal in as many games.

Borussia Mönchengladbach, meanwhile, have endured a poor season. With just one win in their first 10 games of the campaign, the North Rhine-Westphalia outfit now face a genuine threat of relegation for the first time in two decades.
